title: JengaSec application log line
description: One JSON object per line on stdout. Everything an application logs must fit this shape.

event.description: What happened, lower_snake_case: login_success, login_failure, transfer_created, record_exported

request_id.description: Same value across all lines for one request

source_ip.description: Client address as your app sees it

user.description: Account or session identifier, never a password or token

target.description: What was acted on: an account id, a record id, an endpoint

severity.description: Only if your app judges it; the platform may override

detail.description: Anything else, as key/value. No secrets, no card numbers, no full identity documents.
